hero.headline: Prism Bloom Exercise
body: Prism Bloom Exercise is a free outdoor exercise and activity community focused on helping people stay active, social, and connected through outdoor events and group activities.
Our events are free to attend and open to the community. Activities can include walking, biking, hiking, kayaking, and a wide variety of other outdoor meetups and adventures.

If an activity requires equipment, such as a kayak, participants are expected to bring their own equipment or rent locally. When possible, rental options and recommendations are provided ahead of events through the community Discord.

sections.title: About Prism Bloom Exercise
body: Prism Bloom Exercise is a free outdoor exercise and activity community focused on helping people stay active, social, and connected through outdoor adventures and group events.
The group is currently centered around Anoka and nearby areas, with plans to continue growing into new locations and communities over time.
The community focuses on creating welcoming outdoor events where people can participate at their own pace while meeting others with similar interests.

Activities may include walking, hiking, biking, kayaking, fitness meetups, seasonal outdoor activities, and community driven event ideas. Prism Bloom Exercise supports a wide range of outdoor activities and difficulty levels. Some events are designed for relaxed and beginner friendly participation, while others may involve more demanding physical activity, distance, terrain, endurance, or outdoor experience.

All standard events are free to attend. Some activities may require personal equipment such as kayaks, bicycles, or other outdoor gear. Participants are responsible for bringing their own equipment or arranging rentals when needed. Rental suggestions and local options are often shared through the Discord community when available.

Prism Bloom Exercise uses Discord as the primary event, planning, and discussion hub. Additional social platforms are primarily used for sharing photos, updates, community content, and occasional event schedules. The community also maintains Google Calendars for different location centers to help members track upcoming activities and events.

The Discord community includes channels and forms where members can discuss events, equipment, activity ideas, and community feedback. If the community wants a new discussion channel or topic area, it can be added to better support member interests and communication.

Community feedback is important to the group. Members can use forms and discussion channels to suggest events, discuss equipment, coordinate activities, or request new channel types and community features.

Events may change based on weather, safety conditions, or participation needs. Members are encouraged to prepare appropriately for outdoor activities and participate responsibly based on their own comfort level, experience, and ability.
Whether you are looking to stay active, explore new places, meet people, or try new outdoor activities, Prism Bloom Exercise is built to stay flexible, welcoming, and community driven.

sections.title: The Story of Prism Bloom Exercise
body: Prism Bloom Exercise began in 2020 shortly after COVID-19 lockdown restrictions were lifted. What started as a simple way to spend time outdoors with friends and work off the extra weight gained during lockdown quickly became a recurring tradition.

At the time, there was no official name, logo, or organization. The group existed as a private Snapchat group called 'Outdoor Exercise Group.' Membership was entirely by invitation, meaning the only way to join was to know someone already participating. The focus was simple: get outside, stay active, and enjoy time with friends. Activities were informal and often included walking, biking, hiking, and exploring local parks and trails.
Because most members were students, the group naturally slowed down and eventually stopped once the school year resumed in the fall.

The following year, after school let out for the summer, the group returned. What had started as a one-time idea became a seasonal tradition. Each spring and summer, members would reconnect, organize outings, and invite friends to join. The group remained relatively small and informal, operating without a dedicated identity beyond its shared goal of outdoor exercise and recreation.

As participation continued to grow, the limitations of Snapchat became more noticeable. By 2024, the group had outgrown the platform and transitioned to Discord. The move resulted in some longtime members leaving while new members joined, creating a community that naturally grew and shrank with the seasons. This was also the first year the group became publicly accessible. A public invite link was shared on Snapchat, allowing anyone interested to join rather than relying solely on personal invitations.

In 2025, efforts began to expand the community beyond Discord. A Facebook page was created to give members a place to share photos and stay connected outside of events. However, the community still lacked a distinct name, logo, or visual identity, so the page saw limited activity. Despite this, growth continued. This was also the first year physical flyers were placed at parks and event locations, helping introduce the group to people who happened to encounter events in progress.
The year 2026 marked a major turning point.
For the first time, the community received an official name: Prism Bloom Exercise.

The name was chosen to reflect both the spirit and history of the group. 'Prism' represents the rainbow imagery that had become common throughout advertisements and promotional materials. 'Bloom' symbolizes the group's tendency to come alive each spring as people returned outdoors after winter. 'Exercise' remains a direct reference to the group's original purpose and continuing mission: encouraging people to get outside, stay active, and enjoy outdoor recreation together.

With a name in place, branding soon followed. A logo was created featuring a fresh rainbow bloom shining like a prism. A matching backdrop was developed featuring a solitary tree standing above a series of cascading rainbow waterfalls. Inspired by the hidden gems, scenic locations, and unexpected discoveries often found along event routes, the scene captures light shining through the falls like a prism, casting vibrant colors across the landscape.

Once the branding was established, the community's online presence began to expand rapidly. Discord and Facebook were updated to match the new identity, while Instagram and Snapchat accounts were created to help members stay connected and share experiences across multiple platforms. Shortly afterward, the first official website was launched, providing a central location for community information, event details, and resources.

2026 also marked the beginning of a major technological transition behind the scenes. Event planning, which had previously been managed manually, began moving toward an automated system. Routes, locations, activities, and event information started being organized within a dedicated database, laying the foundation for automated event generation, scheduling tools, route management, and future community growth.

What began as a small private group of friends looking for a reason to get outside after lockdown has gradually evolved into a growing outdoor recreation community. While the tools, branding, and organization have changed over the years, the core mission remains the same: creating opportunities for people to explore the outdoors, stay active, discover new places, and connect with others through shared experiences.

sections.title: Disclaimer
body: Participation in Prism Bloom Exercise events and activities is completely voluntary. Outdoor activities may involve inherent risks including, but not limited to, physical injury, bodily harm, property damage, weather conditions, terrain hazards, wildlife, water related risks, transportation risks, or actions taken by other individuals.

By participating in any Prism Bloom Exercise activity or event, participants acknowledge and accept these potential risks and agree to take personal responsibility for their own safety, preparedness, equipment, actions, and wellbeing.

Prism Bloom Exercise, its organizers, event planners, volunteers, participants, partnered locations, parks, property owners, and associated individuals are not responsible or liable for injuries, damages, losses, accidents, or incidents that may occur during or related to participation in activities or events.
Participants are expected to act responsibly, follow applicable laws and safety guidance, respect others, and use reasonable judgment while participating in events and activities.
